parts.name: duck
sources: World: a smooth skin around the bones of World (World.Blob), plates, a beak, toes and eyes (scripts/bird_template.exs). AGPL-3.0, as World
A white domestic duck (vịt, a Pekin duck): about 50 cm high when it stands, creamy white feathers, a long wide yellow-orange bill, short yellow-orange legs.

Wikipedia, American Pekin (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/American_Pekin): "The plumage is creamy white"; "The beak is yellow", "fairly short, and almost straight"; "the legs and feet are a yellowish orange"; the body is "held at about 40º to the horizontal" and "the tail projects above the line of the back"; males 4.5 kg, females 4.1 kg.

The height (50 cm), the bill (1.7 times the length and 2 times the width of the beak of the template), the short legs, the long neck: a guess from photos of iNaturalist (https://www.inaturalist.org/photos/662513197, https://www.inaturalist.org/photos/52357233). The body of the template is more level than 40º, and the feet have no webs.
The time and the length of a step: a guess.
